atAGlance: Bánh xèo chay is a vegetarian turmeric-rice pancake eaten by tearing pieces into rice paper or lettuce with herbs, then dipping in a vegetarian nước chấm-style dip.
whatItIs: Bánh xèo chay keeps the crisp pancake and wrap-and-dip ritual of bánh xèo, but swaps meat and shrimp for mushrooms, tofu, bean sprouts, or vegetables.
howToEnjoy: Tear a crisp piece, wrap it with rice paper or lettuce and herbs, then dip lightly. Ask whether the dip is vegetarian before you start if that matters.
howLocalsOrder: Order bánh xèo chay and make chay clear for both filling and dip. Ask for extra bánh tráng, extra herbs, or không nước mắm before the plate arrives.
worthKnowing: The local eating move is the same as bánh xèo: crisp pancake plus herbs, rice paper or lettuce, and a bright dip in one hands-on bite.
goodToKnow: Ask whether the nước chấm is vegetarian; some mixed stalls use fish sauce even when the pancake filling is meat-free.
travelerCaution: Confirm the nước chấm is vegetarian if strict.
